product.name: Monoprice 12-in-1 Dual-HDMI + VGA MST Dock
product.description: Monoprice™12‑in‑1 Triple Display Docking StationDual 4K HDMI, VGA, 5Gbps USB‑A, Gigabit Ethernet, SD/MicroSD Readers, 100W PD Passthrough Charging, 3.5mm Dual Audio/Microphone JackThe Monoprice™ 12‑in‑1 Dual‑HDMI + VGA MST Dock is a versatile and compact docking solution designed to meet all your workplace setup needs. With its powerful functionality and convenient design, this docking station allows you to extend the capabilities of your device with ease.The main highlight of this docking station is its ability to transform a single USB‑C (with DP1.4 or DP1.2 mode) or Thunderbolt port into an impressive array of 12 ports. This includes two 4K HDMI ports, one 1080p VGA port, four high‑speed USB‑A data ports, a Gigabit Ethernet port, simultaneous SD and MicroSD card readers with a speed of 104Mb/s, a 3.5mm 2‑in‑1 audio/mic port, and a USB‑C port for 100W Power Delivery passthrough charging. With these ports at your disposal, you can effortlessly connect multiple peripherals and accessories, creating a highly productive workstation.Setting up the Monoprice 12‑in‑1 Dual‑HDMI + VGA MST Dock is a breeze. Simply plug it into your device, and you can start using it right away. There is no need for any driver installations or complex configurations. This plug‑and‑play functionality ensures a hassle‑free experience, allowing you to focus on your work without any unnecessary delays.This docking station is compatible with both Windows and MacOS systems, making it suitable for a wide range of devices. Windows users can take advantage of both MST (Multi‑Stream Transport) and SST (Single‑Stream Transport) modes, while MacOS users can utilize SST mode. This ensures seamless compatibility with various operating systems and provides flexibility for different user preferences.One of the key features of the Monoprice 12‑in‑1 Dual‑HDMI + VGA MST Dock is its support for triple external monitor displays. You can connect two 4K high‑resolution HDMI displays and one 1080p VGA display simultaneously, enhancing your visual experience and expanding your screen real estate. This is particularly useful for professionals who require multiple displays for multitasking, content creation, and efficient workflow management.In addition to its display capabilities, this docking station also offers multiple USB‑A ports, enabling you to connect peripheral devices such as mice, keyboards, headsets, and storage drives. With four high‑speed USB‑A data ports operating at 5 Gbps, you can transfer files quickly and efficiently, enhancing your productivity and workflow.Furthermore, the USB‑C ports on this dock support fast 100W Power Delivery passthrough charging. This means that while using the docking station, you can simultaneously charge your host laptop at a rapid rate, ensuring that your device remains powered throughout your work session.The Monoprice 12‑in‑1 Dual‑HDMI + VGA MST Dock is a reliable and efficient docking solution that combines convenience and functionality in a compact form factor. With its wide range of ports, support for multiple displays, fast data transfer speeds, and Power Delivery charging capability, this docking station is a valuable addition to any workspace.
